autoInstallFfmpeg.title: Auto install ffmpeg (Docker only)
autoInstallFfmpeg.description: Docker only: install ffmpeg automatically if it is not found in the container. On other installations, use the Linux install button or install ffmpeg manually.

installFfmpeg.title: Install ffmpeg (Linux only)
installFfmpeg.description: Install ffmpeg now on Linux. Requires root privileges and apk (Alpine) or apt-get (Debian/Ubuntu). Available outside Docker too; unsupported on macOS and Windows.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: Add or remove RTSP cameras here. Use the camera name as the key. Save and restart the plugin to apply changes.

audioSource.title: Audio Source
audioSource.description: RTSP audio URL. Use the video URL for audio from the same stream, or leave empty to disable audio.

play.description: Preview the video URL with ffplay (not available in Docker).

videoResolution.title: Video Resolution
videoResolution.description: Resolution used when capturing from the configured webcam or RTSP camera. auto uses the resolution requested by the controller (the allocated video stream's maxResolution) instead of a fixed value.

videoBitrate.title: Video Bitrate
videoBitrate.description: Target encoder bitrate (kbps) used when capturing from the configured webcam or RTSP camera, regardless of resolution. Default is 1000. Suggested values: ~800 for 640x480, ~2000 for 1280x720, ~2500 for 1920x1080.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
